name: Confirm the Placeholders that decide the pages
principle: Value and resiliency layer: the baseline
protects: Every risk. The cover days at the United States plant, the backup power, the sealed test draw in litres, the cold-head and wire addresses against the Nankai Trough zone, the China plant's logic stock in weeks and the price at which the OEM loses its helium allocation decide whether the first break on each page is real.
why_now: Every other action is sized from these numbers, and all of them are synthetic today. Eleven of eleven lenses rank this first or second.
too_late_after: The 2027 sourcing cycle opens on synthetic numbers
act_if: Act now. Any function that has not returned a number by the end of 2026 is asked again.
pause_if: Never.
look_again_if: Look again if a confirmed value moves a first break by a quarter or turns a break into a cost.
cost_of_waiting: A year of decisions sized on guesses. A capital plan built on synthetic numbers.

name: Test a 30-day manual fallback at both plants and both sole suppliers against a 35-day loss of systems
owner: Site operations with Sourcing, with the wire mill and the cold-head maker in the room
principle: Resilient products and processes: business continuity
protects: The United States plant, the China plant, the wire mill, the cold-head maker, the gas carriers and the port terminal. The 35-day encryption event is the one break every future carries, and it lands wherever each future's first break already sits.
why_now: The shared break has no external clock, so the test is the only clock. Eleven of eleven lenses say it works in every future. The people who ran the line on paper are the ones nearest retirement.
too_late_after: The first outage, or the retirement of the people who can write the procedure
act_if: Act if any site cannot say today how it ships without its systems, or if a sole supplier or sector peer reports a systems outage of a week or more.
pause_if: Pause once a site has passed a timed test twice.
look_again_if: Look again after any systems migration, if a test fails, or if the drill assumed grid and roads were up.
cost_of_waiting: One more year in which a 35-day stop breaches the line in every future and is largely uninsured, because cyber cover excludes state action.

name: Qualify a second cold-head maker
protects: The cold head, and through it both plants and the installed base. It removes the first break in F2 and F4 and cuts the cost of a cold-head outage in F1 and F3, where helium is the fallback. Four lenses (Foreign trade, Geopolitical, Technology shift, Contrarian) say it works in all four because the same cold head cools conventional magnets too; seven hold it to the sealed futures.
why_now: Requalification takes 18 months, and F4 breaks by 2029. A start after mid-2027 lands after the break. The Contrarian's condition stands: one maker has already left the market, so the action is real only once Sourcing names a second maker with a letter of intent.
act_if: Act if Sourcing names a second maker with a letter of intent, if the sealed share of clearances passes a quarter, or if a producer-country register names cryocoolers or cold heads.
pause_if: Pause if no second maker exists (switch to A2 plus A7), or if the sealed share stays below a quarter in 2028 and conventional builds still dominate.
look_again_if: Look again if the parent announces a review or exit of its cryogenics unit, if a second maker sits inside the same Nankai Trough shaking zone, or if the cold head's own sub-suppliers are shared (A24).
cost_of_waiting: The second source lands after the F4 break and after a tender cycle; in F4 both plants stay stopped into 2030.

name: Keep an offline, restore-tested copy of the design and qualification record
principle: Resilient products and processes: IP ownership and continuity
protects: The design and qualification record, and through it every 18-month requalification on the map. Every future page assumes the record is intact and nothing on the candidate list keeps it so.
why_now: Added by Security and the Contrarian independently. A record loss turns every replacement time into an unknown, and the manual fallback (A9) is robust only inside this assumption.
act_if: Act if a restore of the record has never been timed.
pause_if: Pause if a timed restore inside 30 days already exists.
look_again_if: Look again after any cyber event at the OEM or a sole supplier.
cost_of_waiting: One more year with the assumption every page rests on unverified.

name: Hold helium cover at the United States plant above the container hold plus the ten-day grid rebuild
protects: Helium cover and the United States plant. It removes the first break in F1 and the second break in F3. In F2 and F4 it is carrying cost.
why_now: The F1 break lands in the winter of 2028 to 2029 and can arrive in any hurricane season from 2027. Cover builds slowly at allocated volumes and cannot be bought once the shortage bites. The read date leans toward the two futures where it pays.
act_if: Act if Logistics states cover below the container hold plus ten days, if Gulf transits stay below a quarter of normal into 2027, or if an allocation letter cuts the plant's monthly volume.
pause_if: Pause if the Gulf strait reopens to insured traffic and the allocation letters stop.
look_again_if: Look again if a United States helium allocation rule is proposed, if the sealed test draw is confirmed as a cylinder, or if A8 raises the plant's helium draw.
cost_of_waiting: One 30 to 45 day stop at the United States plant and a quarter of Western installs late.

name: Put the liquefier at the United States plant on backup power off the plant feeder
protects: The United States plant and its helium cover. It covers the cheapest ordinary failure on the map, a winter curtailment, and is harmless elsewhere.
why_now: The Carolinas grid is rated elevated from 2027 and the Midcontinent high from the winter of 2028. A generator takes a year to procure and data centres are buying the same units. The Contrarian warns the panel will under-rate it because it is small.
start_by: The 2027 capital plan, procurement by mid-2027
act_if: Act if Site operations confirms the liquefier shares the plant feeder, or if the grid operator issues a winter curtailment notice for the region.
pause_if: Pause if the feeder is reclassified as critical load or cover at the plant reads above 60 days.
look_again_if: Look again if the sealed share passes half, if the switchgear is reachable from the plant network, or if the backup fuel crosses the feeder's flood zone.
cost_of_waiting: One winter in which the liquefier idles through the first curtailment.

name: Hold logic and cold-head stock at the China plant longer than the licence queue
protects: The China plant, its logic and its cold heads. It is the only action that moves before the first axis settles, and the nearest date on the list.
why_now: The truce notice is first read as 10 November 2026. Stock bought after a listing may itself need a licence. Three lenses add F4, where the logic listing is absorbed with stock.
too_late_after: An entity listing names the plant or its logic supplier
act_if: Act if the truce is not renewed at its notice date, or if a listing names any supplier to the China plant.
pause_if: Pause if the truce is renewed for a year or more with no listing.
look_again_if: Look again once Sourcing states the stock in weeks, if the licence queue shortens, or if the warehouse sits in the flood plain.
cost_of_waiting: The F3 break lands on empty shelves and the stop runs the full licence queue.

name: Sign a multi-year supply agreement with the cold-head maker's parent, with a change-of-control clause and step-in rights to tooling and drawings
protects: The cold head against owner exit. Nine lenses hold it to F4 because a contract moves neither a licence nor a flood. Financial says it works in all four if it carries a change-of-control clause.
why_now: The 2027 sourcing cycle is the last normal negotiation before the parent's next capacity review. One sale document can end the line.
too_late_after: The parent announces a sale, a review or an exit
act_if: Act if the parent's filings show its cryogenics unit shrinking, under review or below group margin.
pause_if: Pause if A1 qualifies a second maker, or if the parent invests in the plant.
look_again_if: Look again if a listing names cryocoolers, if the parent changes hands, or if the yen moves more than fifteen percent against the dollar.
cost_of_waiting: Negotiating from a queue; in F4 the whole gap uncovered.

name: Confirm the control classifications of wire, cold heads and logic and the China plant's licence approval rate
protects: The wire, the cold heads, the logic and the China plant. F3 and F4 rest on classifications nobody has checked, and magnet-grade wire has never been read against the dual-use lists.
why_now: It costs nothing and decides whether A5 and A6 are bets or waste. Added by Geopolitical and Foreign trade independently.
act_if: Act regardless.
pause_if: Never.
look_again_if: Look again at every control-list revision.
cost_of_waiting: A5 and A6 are bought against a guess, and the sole wire source sits under an unknown rule.

name: Run an annual credit and ownership watch on the wire mill and the cold-head parent
protects: The wire and the cold head. The first axis counts an owner's exit as a stop, and an exit reads in filings before the press.
why_now: Trivial cost. The cold-head parent's MR revenue share is itself a Placeholder.
act_if: Act if either parent's relevant revenue falls under five percent of the group.
pause_if: Never.
look_again_if: Look again if ownership changes.
cost_of_waiting: An exit seen in the press instead of in the filings a year earlier.

name: Run a correlated-hazard test: one hurricane against the plant, the port and the helium lanes together, one Nankai event against the cold-head and compressor makers together
protects: The United States plant, the export port, the gas carriers, the oversize road, the cold-head maker and the compressor maker. The candidate list tests nodes one at a time and weather does not.
why_now: The continuity plan tests nodes singly. One Atlantic storm closes three nodes in a month.
act_if: Act if the continuity plan tests nodes singly.
pause_if: Never.
look_again_if: Look again after each named storm.
cost_of_waiting: One season exposed to a stop the single-node plans do not see.

name: Qualify a logic path that is not United States-origin for the Asian build
principle: Resilient products and processes: design ownership
protects: The logic and the China plant. It shortens the F3 stop rather than preventing it, because 18 months from early 2027 lands at or after the break, and a foreign-made part can still be caught by the foreign direct product rule. Five lenses add F4, where it shortens the licence queue; the Contrarian notes it spends design ownership.
why_now: Only a start in the first quarter of 2027 lands before 2029.
act_if: Act if an entity listing names the China plant's logic supplier, or if licence approvals stay below half for two quarters.
pause_if: Pause if the truce is renewed with no listing, or if A5 covers the licence queue.
look_again_if: Look again if the foreign direct product rule reaches this product class, or if a second foundry clears equivalent parts.
cost_of_waiting: A 2029 answer to a 2027 break; the F3 stop runs the full queue.

name: Size ramp and test capacity at the United States plant to cover part of the Asian build
protects: The China plant's customers. It is the only action that keeps an Asian delivery date when the China plant stops. It is useless in F1, where the United States plant itself fails, and it raises the helium draw at that plant, so the 2027 capital plan must size it with A3.
why_now: Capacity takes 24 months to change and the 2027 capital plan is the only slot. It carries the heaviest working-capital drag on the list.
act_if: Act if a listing names the China plant or its logic supplier, or if the plant's stock falls below the licence queue.
pause_if: Pause if the truce is renewed through 2028, or if a second Asian site is approved.
look_again_if: Look again if helium cover cannot carry the extra draw, if the technicians cannot staff a second shift, or if Asian tenders add local-content rules.
cost_of_waiting: An Asian tender cycle lost; the F3 lane idles two more years.

name: Design and test a hold that keeps a sealed magnet cold for 30 days without a working cold head
protects: The cold head and the sealed installed base. The Contrarian notes the physics may not allow it, so the first step is a cheap study.
why_now: It binds once the sealed share passes half, placed in 2029.
start_by: A study in 2027; the design by 2028
act_if: Act if the sealed share passes a quarter of new builds, or if the study shows a hold above 30 days.
pause_if: Pause if A1 qualifies a second maker, or if the study shows a hold under ten days.
look_again_if: Look again when Engineering states the test draw, or if a conduction-cooled design appears in clearances.
cost_of_waiting: Low until 2028; then a year of sealed fleet with no hold.

name: Build the trade pipeline at the United States plant before the conversion decision
protects: The technicians and the United States plant. Competence takes 18 months and the retirement curve is unmeasured. A retired trade cannot be bought back as a part can.
why_now: The two lines need different trades, and hiring for 2029 starts in 2027.
act_if: Act if more than a quarter of winders and cryogenic technicians retire within five years.
pause_if: Pause if automation removes winding from the floor.
look_again_if: Look again if a competing local employer closes.
cost_of_waiting: A cohort not competent until 2030.

name: Map contract expiries at the plants, the hub and the ports against storm and winter windows
protects: The plants, the hub and the export port. The longshore master contract expires on 30 September 2030, inside hurricane season; a port expiry in a storm month is two stops in one.
why_now: A week of work and nothing to buy.
act_if: Act if any contract expires in 2027 or 2028.
pause_if: Never.
look_again_if: Look again annually.
cost_of_waiting: A known date arrives unplanned.

name: Rewrite delivery clauses, agree a late-delivery remedy script and publish delivery performance before health systems do
owner: Install PMO with the S&OP council
protects: Share. It changes what a late install costs, not whether it happens. All four futures breach the line somewhere, and whether tenders score late delivery at all is unverified.
why_now: Frameworks renew on multi-year cycles.
too_late_after: A health system publishes delivery scores first
act_if: Act if a large customer adds delivery scoring.
pause_if: Pause if tenders never score reliability.
look_again_if: Look again if competitors publish first.
cost_of_waiting: A cycle of unmanaged scores and the first breach's share.

name: Set an allocation rule for scarce magnets
protects: Share where the OEM is one of two or three suppliers. It is a cost modifier in every future.
why_now: The first stop will otherwise be allocated by order date.
act_if: Act if any plant stops.
pause_if: Never.
look_again_if: Look again if tender scoring changes.
cost_of_waiting: The first stop is allocated by order date.

name: Pre-permit an oversize route to a second export port and hold a pre-season helium position there
protects: The export port and the gas carriers. It covers delay in all four futures and a stop only in F1 and F3, where the helium position matters.
why_now: Hurricane season is annual and the single port closes for days in every future.
too_late_after: A closure longer than ten days
act_if: Act if the port closes for ten days, or if its log shows a stop over ten days.
pause_if: Pause if a second berth is contracted, or if cover exceeds the longest closure.
look_again_if: Look again after any bridge posting, or if the second port shares the storm track.
cost_of_waiting: A season of held exports.

name: Contract a second cryogenic carrier with an inland transfer point
protects: The gas carriers and the helium cover. The encryption event at a carrier empties the cover and stops the plant for 50 to 60 days.
why_now: One carrier holds most deliveries.
act_if: Act if one carrier holds over two thirds of deliveries.
pause_if: Pause if cover at the plant reaches 90 days.
look_again_if: Look again yearly.
cost_of_waiting: One more year of the carrier break.

name: Fix helium allocation priority in writing, indexed to a published price, on a lane that avoids the Gulf strait and sanctioned payment rails
protects: The helium supply and the cover. The price at which the OEM loses its allocation is a Placeholder, and without a written priority A3 cannot be built at allocated volumes.
why_now: A chip plant can take priority at any time.
too_late_after: A buyers' market returns or a chip plant takes priority
act_if: Act if a chip plant is reported taking priority, or if Qatar's share of United States imports falls further.
pause_if: Pause if the Gulf strait reopens and a buyers' market returns.
look_again_if: Look again at each allocation letter.
cost_of_waiting: A3 becomes unbuildable.

name: Hedge yen exposure on cold heads and compressors for the contract term
protects: The cold-head and compressor bill. A cost smoother in every future.
why_now: It starts with A2.
act_if: Act if the Japanese central bank changes its rate path.
pause_if: Pause if A2 is priced in dollars.
look_again_if: Look again annually.
cost_of_waiting: Low.

name: Map the cold head's own sub-suppliers before signing a second maker
protects: The cold head. A second maker fed by the same regenerator and displacer sources buys false diversity.
why_now: A study of months that gates A1.
act_if: Act when A1 starts.
pause_if: Pause if the maker shows dual-sourced inputs.
look_again_if: Look again at each qualification.
cost_of_waiting: A1 may buy false diversity.

name: Buy contingent business interruption cover naming the wire mill, the cold-head maker and the helium cover
protects: The bill, not the break, and only if insurers write it. Cyber cover already excludes state action.
why_now: Capacity is withdrawing.
act_if: Act if a broker quotes cover naming the suppliers.
pause_if: Pause if exclusions void it.
look_again_if: Look again if the premium exceeds the cost of A5 stock.
cost_of_waiting: One uninsured year.

name: Require counterfeit avoidance and cyber attestation from sole suppliers and carriers
protects: The wire, the cold head, the electronics, the carriers and the port. Attestation must not replace the tabletop in A9.
why_now: F4 adds a grey-market cold head as a cost, and the OEM's own network is rarely the way in.
act_if: Act if a counterfeit alert names any component class on the map.
pause_if: Never.
look_again_if: Look again at each sourcing cycle.
cost_of_waiting: A year of unverified parts.

name: Decide the OEM's own pace of conversion to sealed magnets, including whether the 3 tesla line converts
principle: Resilient products and processes: engineering flexibility
protects: This is a decision, not a hedge. It chooses which pair of futures the line lives in, trading a Gulf dependency (helium cover) for a Japanese one (the cold head). Waiting a year picks F1 and F3 by default. It raises the value of A1 and A9 if conversion makes one part hold every magnet.
why_now: The 2027 capital plan. The two lines need different trades, and hiring for 2029 starts in 2027.
act_if: Act if the test draw is confirmed as a cylinder and a 3 tesla sealed clearance is filed.
pause_if: Pause if hospitals decline the first sealed option, if the test draw is delivery-sized, or if no second cold-head source exists.
look_again_if: Look again if helium returns to a buyers' market, if a competitor clears 3 tesla sealed, or if tenders score helium independence.
cost_of_waiting: Hiring the wrong trade or none, and one more year on helium terms.
